_comment: Raids beyond the map's edge (PLAN.md). An army from a village marches to the edge of the map on the side of a front (the nearest passable hex of that front on the map's last ring), then fights its way into the enemy's lands: `depth` (1 to maxDepth) field battles, then the siege of the front's stronghold, one every `stageHours` game hours (the first one stage after it reaches the edge). Each enemy force is of the front's troops (as a wave of index = the world's waves so far + stage), `enemy.baseUnits` x `enemy.growthPerStage`^(stage - 1) x `enemy.growthPerWave`^(waves so far), more for bigger groups like hordes, and the deeper the tougher: attack and defense x (1 + `enemy.toughnessPerStage` x (stage - 1)); the stronghold's is `stronghold.sizeFactor` times that, fights from behind its walls (home bonus, defense x (1 + `stronghold.walls`)) in `stronghold.stance`. A field's terrain scales each side's attack and defense (`fields`, picked in a seeded order); field enemies fight in `fieldStance`. An army that wins a battle takes `loot.perKill` per enemy killed (x the front's personality lootFactor), plus `loot.stronghold` for sacking the stronghold, x (1 + `loot.perStage` x (stage - 1)) the deeper it fights and x (1 + `loot.perHatred` x the front's hatred) the more the front hates (its hatred waiting for its next horde, and for the North what the gods' blessings set for good), as far as it can carry: each unit's own `carry` (units.json), wagons the most. Raiding the North brings `north.resourceShare` of that, but each battle won has a chance at a rare find (`north.finds`, per battle; the stronghold's x `north.strongholdFactor`): hero gear for the hero (the leader's, or the owner's), a lore scroll the group hasn't found (for rare research) or a Svarog's Ember for the group. Every battle won makes the next horde of that front hate the more (`hatred.perBattle`; `hatred.stronghold` more for sacking the stronghold). A raid beaten in any battle (or left with no one) comes home with what it carries. The army eats its own grain all the way: it carries what its military reserve and wagons give it. A strike on a gathering horde (`strike`): an army marches to the edge on a scheduled horde's side and at once attacks its encampment (`strike.name`), from behind its walls like a stronghold; only the share of the horde gathered by then fights: all of it at the hour it sets out, down to `strike.minShare` at `strike.gatherHours` game hours or more before it. The troops killed are gone from the horde for good. Win or lose, the front's hatred rises by `strike.hatred` (horde.json hatred: its next horde to set out takes it all). The army comes home after the one battle. Beyond the edge the raid marches a road into the front's lands (road): straight deeper, to the nearest hex of the band past its last field battle, at the army's pace; each field battle comes as it enters the next band, the stronghold at the road's end. A step into a band still in fog takes up to fogFactor times as long, each scout in the army cutting scoutCut of the extra; as it goes the front's lands are seen a band past it. Without a road there, stages come every stageHours.
